optimized_sql:
SELECT d_year, brand_id, brand, sum_agg
FROM (
    SELECT dt.d_year, fi.i_brand_id AS brand_id, fi.i_brand AS brand, SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN (
        SELECT i_item_sk, i_brand_id, i_brand
        FROM item
        WHERE i_manufact_id = 816
    ) AS fi ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = fi.i_item_sk
    JOIN (
        SELECT d_date_sk, d_year
        FROM date_dim
        WHERE d_moy = 11
    ) AS dt ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = dt.d_date_sk
    GROUP BY dt.d_year, fi.i_brand, fi.i_brand_id
) AS agg
ORDER BY d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
